questions.question_english:
Consider the following elements of a note:
I. Statement of the case
II. Rules/Precedents applicable
III. Possible alternative solutions
IV. Recommendation of the initiating officer
What is the correct logical flow of these elements in a comprehensive policy note?
options_english: Statement of the case, Rules/Precedents applicable, Possible alternative solutions, Recommendation of the initiating officer.
Rules/Precedents applicable, Statement of the case, Recommendation of the initiating officer, Possible alternative solutions.
Recommendation of the initiating officer, Possible alternative solutions, Rules/Precedents applicable, Statement of the case.
Statement of the case, Possible alternative solutions, Rules/Precedents applicable, Recommendation of the initiating officer.
questions.explanation_english: A comprehensive policy note follows a logical structure. It begins with a clear statement of the case facts, followed by relevant statutory rules and past precedents. Next, it analyzes possible alternative solutions along with their implications, and concludes with the specific, reasoned recommendation of the initiating officer for decision.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। एक व्यापक नीति नोट एक तार्किक संरचना का पालन करता है। यह मामले के तथ्यों का स्पष्ट विवरण देने से शुरू होता है, इसके बाद संबंधित वैधानिक नियम और पिछले नजीराएँ आती हैं। इसके बाद, संभावित वैकल्पिक समाधानों का विश्लेषण किया जाता है और अंत में निर्णय के लिए प्रारंभिक अधिकारी की विशिष्ट, तर्कसंगत सिफारिश दी जाती है।
questions.topic: File Management Correspondence Noting and Drafting
key_facts: A logical flow is essential for effective communication in policy notes.
Understanding the structure aids in drafting comprehensive notes.
Printed answer key: (A) I, II, III, IV

questions.question_english: What is the standard purpose of keeping a “Standing Guard File” in a government section?

To keep key orders, circulars, and precedents on a subject for reference.

questions.question_english:
Which of the following is the most appropriate action before putting up a new receipt to the higher authorities?
(A) Immediately prepare a draft reply without examining any historical context or connected files in the section.
(B) Store the incoming receipt inside a temporary general folder until a higher administrative authority reviews it.
(C) Locate the relevant file, link past correspondence, and write a factual note.
(D) Send the receipt directly to higher authorities without any context.
options_english: Immediately prepare a draft reply without examining any historical context or connected files in the section.
Store the incoming receipt inside a temporary general folder until a higher administrative authority reviews it.
Locate the relevant file, link past correspondence, and write a factual note.
Send the receipt directly to higher authorities without any context.
questions.explanation_english: Before putting up a new receipt to higher authorities, dealing staff must trace connected background papers, locate or open the appropriate file, flag prior relevant correspondence, and record a concise factual note. This preliminary preparation gives decision-makers complete contextual clarity and rule references required to process the case effectively.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। नए प्राप्ति को उच्च अधिकारियों के समक्ष प्रस्तुत करने से पहले, संबंधित पृष्ठभूमि पत्रों का पता लगाना, उचित फ़ाइल को खोलना, पिछले पत्राचार को चिह्नित करना और एक संक्षिप्त तथ्यात्मक नोट रिकॉर्ड करना आवश्यक है। यह प्रारंभिक तैयारी निर्णय लेने वालों को आवश्यक संदर्भ स्पष्टता और नियम संदर्भ प्रदान करती है, जिससे मामले को प्रभावी ढंग से संसाधित किया जा सके।
